models.name: Tragedy of the Commons
models.use_when: Individual rational choices damage a shared resource.
models.action_rule: Look for missing ownership, missing cost feedback, or weak governance.

models.name: Rent Dissipation
models.use_when: People compete away the value of a resource.
models.action_rule: Check whether the contest costs more than the prize is worth.

models.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
models.use_when: Mutual cooperation would be better but incentives push each side toward betrayal or defensiveness.
models.action_rule: Use small commitments, repeated interaction, and trust tests to make cooperation safer.

models.name: Information Asymmetry
models.use_when: One side knows more than the other.
models.action_rule: Identify hidden information, screening mechanisms, and verification signals.

models.name: Signal Theory
models.use_when: Words are cheap but actions may reveal intent.
models.action_rule: Look for costly signals, consistency, and incentives behind communication.

models.name: Zero-Sum and Non-Zero-Sum Games
models.use_when: It is unclear whether parties compete for a fixed pie or can expand it.
models.action_rule: Identify whether cooperation can create new value before assuming conflict.

models.name: Asymmetric Warfare
models.use_when: Facing a stronger opponent or constraint.
models.action_rule: Avoid head-on competition; use unique advantages against the other side's weak point.

models.name: Double Bind
models.use_when: Every available response seems wrong because demands conflict.
models.action_rule: Move to meta-level clarification and name the contradictory demands.

models.name: Control Dichotomy
models.use_when: Anxiety comes from trying to control the uncontrollable.
models.action_rule: Separate controllable actions from uncontrollable outcomes.

models.name: Influence Circle
models.use_when: Attention is wasted on issues outside practical influence.
models.action_rule: Move energy from concern to influence to direct control.
